_about: t20 base (D48, card experiments/t20_lane_grid_bundle/experiment.md): t16_full.json plus the bundle of the card. (1) L4: model.lane_branch res4, the frozen ResNet-50 stem + layer 1 at stride 4 on the current frame (lane_images = the key-frame image cache data/cache/img_front, which holds exactly the samples of the large split), lifted with the DualBEV depth and added to the merged dual camera BEV after the temporal block. (2) The 1 m centre-line head in the map head (centreline_1m in the loss and the model; they must agree). (3) The hygiene fixes of records/open_findings_2026-11-02.md (loss.hygiene_2026_11_02: #1 #2 #3 #6) and the dead radar-stationary channel removed (radar_stationary false in the loss and the model, open finding #4: the radar aux head loses one output channel, once, here). (4) The split by name: "split": "large" instead of the 428 / 82 inline scene lists of t16_full.json (the same lists, splits/large.json), so that the config says which sequences it trains on and not 510 names. The trainer does not read the key: `python -m trainsuite start` resolves it into train_scenes / val_scenes before it writes the composed config (splits/README.md), so the run's config.json holds the exact lists; a direct `python training/train.py` on this file stops with 'unknown key'. Nothing else differs from t16_full.json (6000 steps, accum 2, seed 0, the motion block, delta slots, probe). Short bug-finding twin: `--preset small --set split=small --set steps=600` (splits/README.md).
name: t20_base
